BW Black Star Promos

Released March 1, 2011 · 101 cards

Expanded

BW Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on March 1, 2011. It has 101 cards. It includes 93 Pokémon, 8 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

24 illustrators worked on BW Black Star Promos. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (32), Naoki Saito (11), The Pokémon Company Art Team (8), Akira Komayama (6), Shin Nagasawa (6), Eske Yoshinob (5), Mizue (4), Shizurow (4).
